tests.name: T3: failed capability terminal event rolls back success before fatal containment
T4: explicit CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB is refused by the kernel
T7 P27 path prefix cousins and traversal are not containment
F04 J01-J04/J07: provider root is created suspended inside its job, prompt delivered exactly, record persisted
F04 J11-J15/J18/J45: children, grandchildren, short-lived, detached and orphaned descendants are members and end with the session
F04 J16/J17: explicit breakaway is refused by the kernel; a member's own permissive nested job cannot leave Bunny's job
F04 J29-J31/J42: Stop terminates the exact job by handle; unrelated same-image process survives; result is kernel accounting
F04 J05/J21/J44: an admission failure refuses execution and starts nothing; no fallback launcher exists
F04 J47/J48: concurrent sessions are isolated; stopping A leaves B running
F04 J35/J09/J46: abrupt Host death (TerminateProcess, no cleanup code) ends the whole contained tree; unrelated survives
F04 J29/J43/J42: TaskManager Stop reports kernel-verified job emptiness; the job is live code until then
F04 J37-J41/J32: restart reconciles interrupted job records by full identity, kills nothing, and holds while identity is alive
F04 J08/J10: the native job handle carries no SET_ATTRIBUTES right and the module exposes no PID/handle-based job API
R1-containment#0 a worker that exits on its own is settled (its job group closed) before any reopen starts a second worker
containment#3 the build record must name the worker source, and a source edited after the build is refused
containment#4 an overlong line is discarded to its newline even when its tail arrives in later chunks
containment#2 the stdin accounting for the shutdown line is its real byte length
containment#5 a malformed event that throws in a listener is reported and never thrown out of the stdout handler
containment#0 a poll whose inspection fails is unknown state: the job is terminated and closed before the exit is reported
V54 containment intact: the client never reports a worker or process as running when the snapshot says it is not
